headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 21, 2026**
article:
The Detroit Tigers secured a 4-1 victory over the Chicago White Sox, with Dillon Dingler hitting a home run to lead the offense. The Cincinnati Reds dominated the New York Yankees, winning 10-2 behind Sal Stewart's 2 hits and 6 RBIs. The Toronto Blue Jays edged the Chicago Cubs 8-6, with Jeff Hoffman earning the win and Louis Varland notching the save.

Several teams have been impacted by injuries, with the Colorado Rockies placing RHP Blas Castaño on the 15-day injured list due to a right pectoral strain. The Miami Marlins have also made several roster moves, transferring RHP Josh Ekness to the 60-day injured list and placing C Liam Hicks on the 10-day injured list. The Athletics, Texas Rangers, Baltimore Orioles, Los Angeles Dodgers, and Boston Red Sox have also made injury-related roster moves.

The MLB trade market has been active, with several teams making roster moves. The Atlanta Braves traded RHP Tyler Schoff to the Chicago Cubs, while the Cubs also acquired RHP Jayden Murray from the Houston Astros. The Arizona Diamondbacks traded SS Luis Urías to the Toronto Blue Jays for cash, and the Pittsburgh Pirates acquired RHP Hunter Stratton from the Atlanta Braves.

top_news.title: **Tigers Take Down White Sox 4-1**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers secured a 4-1 victory over the Chicago White Sox, with Dillon Dingler leading the offense. Dingler hit a home run (17) on a fly ball to center field, contributing to the Tigers' win.

top_news.title: **Reds Rout Yankees 10-2**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds dominated the New York Yankees, securing a 10-2 victory. Sal Stewart led the Reds' offense with 2 hits, 6 RBIs, and 4 at-bats.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Take Down Cubs in Thrilling 8-6 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays secured an 8-6 win over the Chicago Cubs, with Jeff Hoffman earning the win and Louis Varland notching the save.

top_news.title: **Padres Take Down Rangers in Thrilling 6-4 Victory**
top_news.summary: The San Diego Padres secured a hard-fought win over the Texas Rangers, with a strong performance from their offense and bullpen. Manny Machado led the charge at the plate, going 2-for-5 with a home run and 5 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Cubs Edge Blue Jays in Thrilling 0-0 Showdown**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs secured a narrow victory over the Toronto Blue Jays, winning the game 0-0. Jayden Murray was the only player from the Cubs mentioned in the grounded list.

top_news.title: **Rockies Roster Hit by Injury**
top_news.summary: The Colorado Rockies have placed RHP Blas Castaño on the 15-day injured list due to a right pectoral strain, effective retroactive to June 18, 2026.

top_news.title: **Braves Bolster Rotation with Trade Acquisition**
top_news.summary: The Atlanta Braves have acquired right-handed pitcher Tyler Schoff in a trade with the Washington Nationals.
